g.text: Cooling hardware size predicts its capacity, and so a site's power

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: What it shows: rated cooling capacity against physical footprint for every unit in Epoch's two equipment reference tables.

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 10.2px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: The tight relationship is what lets a rooftop count in an aerial image become a power estimate.

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Data Centers — data_center_cooling_towers.csv and data_center_chillers.csv (CC-BY)

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: 8.6px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Methodology: Epoch AI data centers documentation — cooling equipment reference tables

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Note: These are manufacturer catalogue specifications, not measurements of installed units, and rated capacity is an upper bound that real

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: duty rarely reaches. 669 of 670 catalogue rows carry both a footprint and a capacity and are plotted; the rest are omitted rather

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: than imputed. The median line is a summary of central tendency, not a fitted model, and the three equipment classes have genuinely

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: different intensities, so applying one ratio to a mixed site introduces error.
